relations.quote: I am not counting in a porch.

story.body: You stood through a short Sunday morning. Master Thwaite stopped at seven heads and one turning of the glass. You refused the porch as a place to count money. Sir John Spencer did not speak to you. You came back across the close with the letter still unsent.

story.body: You sat the first boarding of the week. The loaf was a finger short of the notch. You refused her a new plot, told her the letter had no day and had not gone, and did not hire a horse over the dish. The firing sixpence stayed running.
